headline: Estonia Allocates €2.4B Defense Boost Amid Escalating NATO-Russia Tensions
summary: Estonia has reinforced its border posture and implemented a €2.4 billion defense budget expansion as tensions between NATO and Russia mount along the Baltic frontier.
why: Heightened Baltic security concerns drive European defense spending allocations and reshape sovereign fiscal priorities across Eastern Europe.

impacts.name: European Aerospace & Defense
impacts.why: Increased government defense budgets create ongoing procurement opportunities for regional defense contractors.
